content: Once you create a username on WikiDoc, you will have a dedicated User Page. On this page, you can provide information about yourself, including your medical qualifications. It is recommended that you include a brief biography detailing your medical training, degrees, specialty, research, or any other relevant information you would like others to know about you. However, you should not post sensitive information such as your DEA number, medical license number, or any other confidential details. Additionally, you can learn how to upload and insert your picture on this page. This User Page is publicly accessible, meaning that patients or colleagues may view it if they search for your name on Google. WikiDoc also provides a Physician Space Page. You can click on the provided link to see an example of a WikiDoc page. To edit your own page, simply click on your username at the top of the page and make the desired changes. Every registered user is assigned a Discussion Page, also referred to as a Talk Page. To access it, click on the red Discussion tab located at the top of the page. You can use this page to leave messages for other users on their respective discussion pages. It is also important to periodically check your own Discussion Page by clicking on the My Talk link next to your username at the top of the screen. This is where other members of the WikiDoc community may leave messages for you.
